reachability.note: this contradicts my earlier generalisation from C58 that the network was unreachable; that finding applied to the web_fetch tool, and I had over-extended it

the_decisive_fact.what: all three files carry integer codes in treatment_mapping_names and sample_mapping_names, and contain no annotation fields at all
the_decisive_fact.examples: treatment names read as ['-1','0','0','0','0','0'] and sample names as ['0','1','10','11',...]
the_decisive_fact.so: there is no drug identity to attach a pathway label to, hence the pathway claim cannot be tested on any of them regardless of readout quality

even_the_best_readout_is_unusable.reading: its readout is not saturated, which was the failure mode of PAIR. But without knowing which drugs were tested, the annotation cannot be attached and the claim still cannot be tested.

the_two_data_surfaces_have_complementary.batchie_pair: drug identity present (Drug 1 / Drug 2 are real names), pathway annotation never obtained
the_two_data_surfaces_have_complementary.so: no single arena has all three of a usable readout, drug identity, and annotation

this_upgrades_the_block.before: there might be a third arena in files not yet downloaded
this_upgrades_the_block.now: the three candidate files were obtained and surveyed; all lack drug identity, so the unfreeze condition fails on verified data content rather than on access
this_upgrades_the_block.significance: this is a real exclusion rather than another note
